hooks.command: in=$(cat); p=$(printf %s "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$p" in */.claude/*|*/.claude) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PermissionRequest","decision":{"behavior":"allow"}}}';; esac

in=$(cat); cmd=$(printf %s "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); segs=$(printf %s "$cmd" | sed 's/&&/\n/g; s/||/\n/g; s/;/\n/g'); all=1; any=0; while IFS= read -r seg; do seg=$(printf %s "$seg" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//'); [ -z "$seg" ] && continue; any=1; verb=$(printf %s "$seg" | awk '{print $1}'); case "$verb" in echo) : ;; rm|rmdir) rest=$(printf %s "$seg" | awk '{$1=""; print substr($0,2)}'); sall=1; sany=0; for tok in $rest; do case "$tok" in -*) continue ;; esac; sany=1; case "$tok" in */.claude/*|*/.claude|'~/.claude'*|'$HOME/.claude'*|'$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR'*) : ;; *) sall=0; break ;; esac; done; if [ "$sany" != 1 ] || [ "$sall" != 1 ]; then all=0; break; fi ;; cat|ls|head|tail|wc|stat|find|grep|rg|jq|tree|file|mkdir|touch|mv|cp|tee) if ! printf %s "$seg" | grep -qE '(/\.claude(/|$|[[:space:]])|~/\.claude|\$HOME/\.claude|\$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR)'; then all=0; break; fi ;; *) all=0; break ;; esac; done <<EOF
$segs
EOF
if [ "$any" = 1 ] && [ "$all" = 1 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PermissionRequest","decision":{"behavior":"allow"}}}'; fi
